content.short: Replit is a comprehensive software development platform that enables creating online projects from any device.
content.description: Originally founded and launched in 2016, Replit is a complete development framework that lets users create online projects from any device, with support for more than 50 programming languages and a global community of over 15 million software creators. The platform’s versatility is complemented by the Replit Mobile App, which enables users to instantly develop and deploy software from anywhere, while also allowing them to work collaboratively with other developers on shared projects, regardless of location.
content.meta: Replit is a comprehensive software development platform for building online projects across devices. Discover Replit and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: The Self-Driving Company
resources.tldr: Code output nearly tripled in six months while review times and incident rates held. Whether you believe the numbers, the operational detail is good.

resources.title: Evaluating and Improving an Agent at Scale
resources.tldr: Users arrive with a goal in natural language and no repo, tests or framework. How do you measure whether the agent did well?

resources.title: AI Adoption Starts With Truth
resources.tldr: One confidently wrong answer and a user stops trusting the tool entirely. Makes the case that a reliable data layer is the prerequisite, not the polish.
